title: 1999 HMMT February Geometry Problem 6
statement: A sphere of radius 1 is covered in ink and rolling around between concentric spheres of radii 3 and 5. If this process traces a region of area 1 on the larger sphere, what is the area of the region traced on the smaller sphere?

solutions.text: The figure drawn on the smaller sphere is just a scaled down version of what was drawn on the larger sphere, so the ratio of the areas is the ratio of the surface area of the spheres. This is the same as the ratio of the squares of the radii, which is \(\frac{9}{25}\).
